description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that serves as the entry point for an app demonstrating sliding tabs with color customization. It manages UI components, menus, logging setup, and fragment transactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that initializes the UI, manages fragment transactions, options menu, and sets up logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity, inflates the layout, and adds the main fragment if none exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from menu resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu items, toggling visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, including log wrapping, filtering, and display within a fragment.
